author: Zeeb
body:
Hello everyone, I'm Lewzz. I'm here because I recently made like 10 monuments and they don't appear on my profile.
Why is this for? 
Have a nice day, cya!

EDIT: I'm literally breaking monuments since 1 week and they ARE NOT counting for me, RIGHT NOW I'm destroying some at DTM and nothing... stats are broken for me I think. Can you help me please?

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body: The leaderboards only update every week or so. So it won't show the monuments right away. When it does update then the monuments will show.
